Quick reference · 0002

Dotenv loader matrix

Identify which component turns a text file into process variables.

InvocationAutomatic dotenv?Authority
bun app.tsYesBun
bun run scriptYesBun
bun --env-file=FILE app.tsExplicit fileBun
bun run --no-env-file app.tsNoParent process/platform
npm run scriptNot by npmWhatever the script starts
node app.jsNoParent process
node --env-file=FILE app.jsExplicit fileNode
source FILEExecutes shell syntaxCurrent shell
Trace: file → loader → process environment → child process. If you cannot name each arrow, you cannot reliably predict the value.

Production default

Prefer platform-injected variables or secrets in CI/CD, containers, and Cloudflare. When using Bun, consider --no-env-file so an accidentally copied dotenv file cannot silently become another configuration source.

Important caveat

Frameworks and deployment tools may implement their own file names and precedence. npm not loading dotenv itself does not mean a command launched by npm cannot load dotenv.
